entries.title: Let a crewmate's browser open private sites you allow
entries.body: Settings → General → Private sites lists the sites on an office, home or VPN network that a crewmate's browser may open, on every computer that runs your work. Add a name such as wiki.corp.example, or a suffix such as .corp.example.com for every name under it. When a crewmate needs a site that is not listed, your first mate asks you on a card, and your Allow adds it. A listed site opens over https or http, by its name only, and never reaches a program that listens only inside this computer, or cloud metadata addresses.

picture.alt: Settings, General, Private sites, listing wiki.corp.example and .corp.example.com, each with Remove, above a field to add another
